name: schedule_create
description: Create a new schedule. A schedule runs a prompt on a cron expression against a target agent or session. Use run_mode to specify how the prompt is delivered: 'direct' sends it to the parent session, 'delegate_new' creates a fresh sub-session each run, 'delegate_existing' reuses a specific session. Use standard cron syntax (e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' for weekdays at 9 AM).

prompt.description: The message or instruction to send when the schedule fires

cron_expression.description: Cron expression defining when the schedule runs (e.g. '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9 AM)

agent_id.description: ID or name of the agent that owns this schedule (parent session's agent)

session_id.description: ID of the parent session to attach this schedule to

name.description: Display name for the schedule (auto-generated from prompt if omitted)

color.description: Color identifier for the schedule card (e.g. 'blue', 'green', 'slate')

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the cron expression (e.g. 'America/New_York')

run_mode.description: 'direct' sends the prompt as a message to the parent session. 'delegate_new' creates a fresh sub-session each run. 'delegate_existing' routes to a specific existing session each run.

delegate_session_id.description: Target session ID when run_mode is 'delegate_existing'

delegate_session_type.description: Sub-session type to create when run_mode is 'delegate_new'

delegate_agent_id.description: Agent override for the delegated session (defaults to parent session's agent)

tool_name.description: Low-level: tool name when action_type is 'tool'. Prefer run_mode instead.
